title.rendered: SCS Awarded #2 Best Elementary Charter School

content.rendered: Niche, an independent community research organization, has ranked SCS the #2 Best Elementary Charter School in Oregon! We are also ranked #3 Best Charter Middle School in Oregon, with our middle school teachers ranked #1 in the state. We know SCS is a fantastic place for our students to thrive and love learning, and it is so great that the word is spreading!
